events.name: Festival do Perceve de Vila do Bispo
events.blurb: Annual seafood festival in nearby Vila do Bispo celebrating the perceve (gooseneck barnacle) harvested along the Costa Vicentina, with local shellfish, food stalls and live concerts. Organised by the Camara Municipal de Vila do Bispo.

events.name: Festival dos Descobrimentos (Lagos)
events.when: annually late April to early May; 2026 edition (12th) 30 April-4 May
events.blurb: Lagos' flagship historical festival commemorating Portugal's Age of Discoveries, with a large costumed procession, a 16th-century fair, historical reenactments, crafts, music and food. The 2026 theme is From Lagos to Japan.

events.name: Banho 29 (Lagos and Praia da Luz)
events.when: annually on 29 August (with weekend programme); 2026 around 29 August
events.blurb: Traditional Algarve end-of-summer celebration centred on a midnight sea swim, held in Lagos (Meia Praia, Praia da Batata) and nearby Praia da Luz, now a multi-day event with music, exercise classes and entertainment.

events.name: Carvoeiro Black & White Night
events.when: annually mid-to-late June around the summer solstice; 2026 edition 20 June
events.blurb: Large open-air street party in the wider western Algarve marking the start of summer, with multiple live-music stages, food stands and entertainment, and a black-and-white dress code. Note this is in Carvoeiro, toward the eastern edge of the Lagos region.

events.name: Carvoeiro Black & White Night
events.when: annually in June (opens the summer season); 2026 edition on 20 June
events.blurb: One of the Algarve's biggest street parties, held in Carvoeiro village and on the beach. Tens of thousands of visitors dress head-to-toe in black and white; multiple stages host live acts and DJs from evening until the early hours, with the beach becoming a giant open-air dance floor at midnight. Free entry.

events.name: FATACIL
events.when: annually in late August; 2026 edition (45th) on 21-30 August
events.blurb: Lagoa's flagship Fair of Handicrafts, Tourism, Agriculture, Commerce and Industry, one of the Algarve's largest summer fairs. Around 700 exhibitors, regional gastronomy, agriculture and handicraft stands, plus dozens of concerts across three stages over ten days at the Parque Municipal de Feiras e Exposicoes de Lagoa.

events.name: Festa de Nossa Senhora da Encarnacao (Carvoeiro patron saint festival)
events.when: annually on the last Sunday of August
events.blurb: Traditional religious festivities honouring the patron saint of Carvoeiro, held in the fishing village with a procession and local celebrations.

events.name: Lagoa Jazz Fest
events.when: annually in July; 2026 edition on 17-19 July
events.blurb: Annual jazz festival staged in the town of Lagoa, featuring live performances over a long weekend as part of the municipality's summer cultural programme.

events.name: Mercado de Culturas a Luz das Velas (Candlelit Market)
events.when: annually in early July; 2026 edition on 2-5 July
events.blurb: Lagoa's atmospheric candlelit market in the historic town centre, with the streets lit by candles, music, crafts, food and a cultural programme over several evenings.

events.name: Lagoa Wine Show (Mostra de Vinhos)
events.when: annually in early June; 2026 edition on 5-9 June
events.blurb: Regional wine fair in Lagoa showcasing Algarve wines and local producers, with tastings, food and entertainment.

events.name: Festas de Nossa Senhora da Luz / Lagoa Municipal Holiday
events.when: annually in early-mid September; 2026 edition on 6-9 September
events.blurb: Lagoa's patron-saint festivities coinciding with the municipal holiday, featuring religious celebrations, music and community events.

events.name: Carvoeiro Black & White Night (Noite Branca e Preta)
events.when: annually in June; 2026 edition on 20 June (8:30 PM to 3:00 AM)
events.blurb: Iconic street party in Carvoeiro where the village dresses in black and white, with live music, DJs and dance performances spread across several stages near the beach.

events.name: FATACIL
events.when: annually in late August; 2026 edition 21-30 August
events.blurb: Lagoa's flagship fair (Feira de Artesanato, Turismo, Agricultura, Comercio e Industria), one of southern Portugal's largest events, with ten days of concerts, handicrafts, agriculture and regional promotion. 2026 line-up includes Tony Carreira and Festa M80.

events.name: Lagoa Wine Show (Mostra de Vinhos de Lagoa)
events.when: annually in early June; 2026 edition 5-9 June
events.blurb: Annual wine fair in Lagoa celebrating the region's wines with tastings, food and live entertainment.

events.name: Lagoa Jazz Fest
events.blurb: Three-day jazz festival held in Lagoa featuring live jazz performances.

events.name: Mercado de Culturas a Luz das Velas (Candlelit Cultures Market)
events.when: annually in early July; 2026 edition 2-5 July
events.blurb: Atmospheric candlelit market in Lagoa's historic centre with crafts, music, food and cultural performances by candlelight.

events.name: Mostra de Doce Conventual (Conventual Sweets Show)
events.when: annually late July to early August; 2026 edition 29 July - 2 August
events.blurb: Gastronomy fair in Lagoa dedicated to traditional Portuguese conventual sweets, with tastings and regional pastry producers.

events.name: Festivities of Nossa Senhora da Luz / Lagoa Municipal Holiday
events.when: annually in early September; 2026 edition 6-9 September
events.blurb: Traditional religious and civic festivities marking Lagoa's municipal holiday, honouring the patron Nossa Senhora da Luz.

events.name: Afro Nation Portugal
events.when: annually early July on the beach at Praia da Rocha; 2026 edition 3-5 July
events.blurb: The world's largest Afrobeats festival, staged directly on Praia da Rocha beach in Portimão with hip hop, R&B, dancehall and Afrobeats acts. Headliners for 2026 include Wizkid, Burna Boy, Asake and Tyla.

events.name: Festival da Sardinha (Portimão Sardine Festival)
events.when: annually in early-to-mid August at Portimão's riverside (Zona Ribeirinha), about 3 km from Praia da Rocha; typically runs around 5 days in the first half of August
events.blurb: The Algarve's most famous gastronomic festival, celebrating Portimão's fishing heritage with grilled sardines, regional food and craft stalls, plus free nightly concerts by Portuguese artists. Free entry.

events.name: Réveillon Portimão (New Year's Eve celebrations)
events.when: annually 30-31 December at the Portimão riverside, with free concerts from 22:00 and a midnight pyromusical fireworks show launched from the riverside, Alvor and the Praia da Rocha pier
events.blurb: Two evenings of free open-air concerts at Portimão's riverside culminating in a multimedia pyromusical fireworks display over the Arade River, with fireworks also launched from the Praia da Rocha pier at midnight.

events.name: Carvoeiro Black & White Night
events.when: 2026-06-20 (annually around the summer solstice in June)
events.blurb: Free open-air street party in nearby Carvoeiro where roughly 30,000 visitors dress in black and white to mark the summer solstice, with multiple stages of live music, DJs, dance and family entertainment from evening until early morning.

events.name: FATACIL
events.blurb: Lagoa's flagship craft, tourism, agricultural, commercial and industrial fair, running ten days with concerts, business and handicraft stands, agriculture and regional promotion. It is the main annual event of the Lagoa municipality that administers Albandeira Beach.

events.name: Lagoa Wine Show (Mostra de Vinhos de Lagoa)
events.blurb: Annual wine fair in Lagoa showcasing the wines of the Lagoa demarcated region alongside regional food and live entertainment.

events.name: Lagoa Jazz Fest
events.blurb: Annual jazz festival held in Lagoa over a July weekend, part of the municipality's summer cultural programme.

events.name: Feira de Sant'Iago
events.when: 2026-07-23 to 2026-08-02 (annually late July to early August)
events.blurb: Setúbal's largest popular festival, held for over 400 years, drawing around 400,000 visitors with concerts by local, national and international artists, artisan stalls, food stands and amusements at Parque Sant'Iago.

events.name: Festival do Choco
events.blurb: An annual gastronomic festival celebrating Setúbal's signature dish, choco frito (fried cuttlefish), with more than 50 participating restaurants across the municipality serving cuttlefish prepared in many traditional ways.

events.name: Festival do Moscatel
events.blurb: A regional wine festival in neighbouring Palmela celebrating Moscatel de Setúbal, with tastings, showcooking, workshops and street food inspired by the area's sweet aromatic wine.

events.name: Festas de São Pedro (Setúbal)
events.when: annually in June (around São Pedro's day, 29 June)
events.blurb: Setúbal's summer popular saint's festivities at Praça de São Pedro, with several nights of grilled sardines, traditional Bailarico dancing and Marchas Populares parades.

events.name: Festival da Batata-Doce de Aljezur (Aljezur Sweet Potato Festival)
events.blurb: Aljezur's flagship gastronomic festival celebrating its PGI-certified sweet potato, with traditional and contemporary dishes, sweets, live music and family activities. It draws around 15,000 visitors over a long weekend.

events.name: Festas de Aljezur / Noite A - Noite Multicultural
events.when: annually late August (around 28-29 August, municipality day)
events.blurb: Aljezur's municipal celebrations centred on the 29 August municipality holiday, including the white-themed Noite A multicultural night in the historic centre with concerts before the castle walls, plus a traditional parade and 'holy bath' at Monte Clerigo beach.

events.name: Surf and bodyboard competitions at Praia do Amado / Bordeira
events.when: various dates through the year, mainly autumn-winter swell season
events.blurb: The surf beaches around Carrapateira, especially neighbouring Praia do Amado, regularly host national and international surfing and bodyboarding championships thanks to their consistent Atlantic swells.

events.name: Corrida Popular da Costa Nova do Prado
events.blurb: An annual 10 km popular road race organised by the Ílhavo municipality, starting near the Costa Nova do Prado municipal market and running along the Ria de Aveiro towards Vagueira and back. Includes running, walking and a free children's race.

events.name: Festival do Marisco da Costa Nova
events.when: annually late July / early August (2025 edition: 31 July - 3 August)
events.blurb: A seafood festival held on the Costa Nova do Prado lawn, organised by Illiabum Clube with municipal support, serving mariscadas, stuffed crab and lobster, seafood rice, clams, shrimp and more. Runs across several days with lunch and dinner sittings.

events.name: Mareato
events.when: annually in July (2025 edition across two weekends, 3-6 and 11-13 July)
events.blurb: A summer cultural festival programmed by the Ílhavo municipality across Costa Nova do Prado and Praia da Barra, spread over two July weekends with music and seaside-themed activities.

events.name: Algarve Smooth Jazz Festival
events.blurb: Annual international smooth jazz, soul and funk festival held at the Pine Cliffs Resort, which sits on the red cliffs directly above Praia da Falesia. The 2026 edition runs 12-17 May.

events.name: Festa de Nossa Senhora da Orada (Procissao pelo Mar)
events.blurb: Albufeira's traditional festival honouring Nossa Senhora da Orada, patron saint of fishermen, with a procession by sea in which the image of the Virgin is carried by a flotilla of boats along the coast. Festivities run roughly 3-15 August, peaking on 14 August.

events.name: Albufeira Wine Fair (Feira de Vinhos de Albufeira)
events.blurb: Annual wine fair at the Espaco Multiusos de Albufeira gathering more than 100 exhibitors of regional and national wines. The 2026 edition is scheduled for 17-19 April.

events.name: Albufeira Municipal Holiday (Feriado Municipal)
events.blurb: Albufeira's annual municipal holiday on 20 August, marked by concerts and a fireworks display in the town.

events.name: Feira de Sant'Iago
events.when: 2026-07-23 to 2026-08-02 (annually late July to early August)
events.blurb: Setúbal's centuries-old Sant'Iago Fair, held for over 400 years at Parque Sant'Iago, is one of Portugal's largest fairs, drawing around 400,000 visitors with concerts, crafts, food stalls and rides. The 2026 edition runs from 23 July to 2 August.

events.name: Festroia - Setúbal International Film Festival
events.blurb: Festroia is Setúbal's long-running international film festival showcasing world cinema. Its 24th edition is scheduled for 6 to 15 June 2026.

events.name: Festival do Choco Frito
events.blurb: An annual gastronomic festival in Setúbal celebrating choco frito (fried cuttlefish), the city's signature dish, with participating restaurants across the municipality serving regional cuttlefish specialties.

events.name: Setubailas Festival
events.blurb: An international Latin dance festival held in Setúbal, bringing together dancers for a weekend of workshops, shows and social dancing.

events.name: O Sol da Caparica
events.blurb: The largest festival dedicated to Portuguese-language music, held at the Parque Urbano da Costa da Caparica next to the beach. The 2026 edition runs August 13-16 with artists such as Sara Correia, Quim Barreiros and Nininho Vaz Maia.

events.name: Caparica Surf Fest
events.blurb: A national surf festival on the Costa da Caparica coast (Praia do Paraiso), organised by the local surf association ASCC with the Portuguese Surf Federation. The 2026 edition runs April 3-12 and includes surf, bodyboard and longboard competitions plus the return of the National Clubs Championship.

events.name: Windsurfing and Kitesurfing Competitions at Guincho
events.blurb: Praia do Guincho is regarded as one of Portugal's best windsurfing and kitesurfing spots, with strong northerly winds and waves from spring to autumn. National and international windsurfing competitions are held here each year, and the beach was a stop on the windsurfing World Cup in the 1990s.

events.name: Festas do Mar (Sea Festival)
events.blurb: One of Cascais's largest popular events, held in Cascais Bay with free open-air concerts by national and international artists, gastronomy, and crafts. A highlight is the procession in honour of Our Lady of the Navigators, reflecting the town's maritime heritage.

events.name: Ageas Cooljazz
events.blurb: An annual open-air music festival in Cascais set in the Manuel Possolo Hippodrome and Marechal Carmona Park, blending jazz, soul and pop with big international headliners in a relaxed natural setting.

events.name: Coala Festival Cascais
events.blurb: A two-day festival at the Manuel Possolo Hippodrome celebrating Portuguese-language music, with a 2026 lineup including Caetano Veloso, Slow J, Bonga, Marina Sena and Ana Frango Eletrico.

events.name: Festa do Mar (Porto Dinheiro)
events.blurb: Traditional fishing-community festival held on Porto Dinheiro beach itself, featuring a mass and sea procession in memory of fishermen (with the images of Nossa Senhora de Monserrate and Nossa Senhora da Boa Viagem) and the characteristic 'Pamplona'/vacada (bull run) on the sand.

events.name: Festas do Concelho e São João da Lourinhã
events.blurb: Lourinhã's main annual town festival, combining the municipal holiday (24 June) and São João celebrations at the Municipal Stadium with music, dancing, crafts and regional gastronomy.

events.name: Aguardente DOC Fest Lourinhã
events.blurb: Festival celebrating the Aguardente DOC Lourinhã, Portugal's only demarcated brandy region, with tastings, a seminar and producers; accompanied by a gastronomic fortnight in November.

events.name: Columbus Festival (Festival de Colombo)
events.blurb: Porto Santo's flagship festival, held in the island capital Vila Baleira, recreates 15th and 16th century life with a re-enactment of Christopher Columbus's arrival, historical parades, a period market, concerts, theatre and street animation. Columbus lived on the island after marrying Filipa Moniz, daughter of the first captain-donee.

events.name: Porto Santo Wine Festival (Festa do Vinho)
events.when: annually in the last week of August
events.blurb: An annual harvest celebration on Porto Santo featuring public grape-stomping, complimentary wine tasting and festivities marking the island's wine tradition.

events.name: Feast of Our Lady of Piety (Nossa Senhora da Piedade)
events.blurb: Religious celebration honouring the patron saint of Porto Santo, held at the parish church of Our Lady of Piety in Vila Baleira with processions and traditional festivities.

events.name: Porto Santo Carnival
events.blurb: Porto Santo celebrates Carnival each February with parties, dancing and street parades in Vila Baleira.

events.name: Festas Populares de Almoçageme (Santos Populares / São Pedro)
events.blurb: The village of Almoçageme, in the Colares parish nearest to Praia da Adraga, celebrates the Popular Saints in late June with arraial street parties, traditional food, music, a procession of São Pedro and community activities supported by the Colares Parish Council.

events.name: Festas de São Pedro de Sintra
events.blurb: Sintra's largest traditional street fair and patron-saint celebration, centred on Largo D. Fernando II, featuring food stalls, handicrafts, a fair and nightly live music. It is the main popular festival of the municipality that includes Praia da Adraga.

events.name: Festival de Sintra
events.when: annually in June (2026 edition around 11-21 June)
events.blurb: A long-running classical music and performing-arts festival held in Sintra's historic palaces, churches and auditoriums, with orchestral concerts, recitals, opera, chamber music and dance.

events.name: Festa em Honra de Nossa Senhora de Nazaré
events.blurb: The main annual festival held right at Praia da Aguda, a four-day religious and popular feast honouring Our Lady of Nazaré with candlelit processions, street entertainment, free concerts and fireworks over the sea. It has been celebrated for over a century (114th edition in 2026).

events.name: São João na Praia da Aguda
events.blurb: Saint John's night celebration held at the Praia da Aguda fish auction hall (Lota do Peixe), part of the wider São João do Porto festivities in the Vila Nova de Gaia / Porto region.

events.name: Festival da Batata-doce de Aljezur (Aljezur Sweet Potato Festival)
events.blurb: One of southern Portugal's biggest autumn food festivals, celebrating Aljezur's protected-designation sweet potato with 100+ exhibitors, street-food stalls and tastings. The 28th edition ran 28-30 November 2025 and the event returns in 2026.

events.name: Aljezur Surf Fest
events.blurb: A multi-week festival on the Costa Vicentina combining surf competitions at Arrifana beach (including a stage of the Southern Regional Circuit) with environmental, cultural and music events. The 2026 edition ran from late March into early May.

events.name: Festa dos Pescadores da Arrifana (Arrifana Fishermen's Feast)
events.blurb: A traditional fishermen's festival at Portinho da Arrifana near Aljezur featuring a procession at sea, religious ceremonies, grilled sardines, food and entertainment. An adjoining Arrifana Sunset Festival follows the next day.

events.name: Aljezur Municipal Holiday Commemorations
events.blurb: Aljezur marks its municipal holiday on 29 August with civic and cultural celebrations, one of the town's recurring annual festivities alongside its Multicultural Night and Earth Fair.

events.name: Aljezur Surf Fest
events.blurb: An annual surf festival organized by Clube Surf de Aljezur, with regional surf circuit competitions held directly at Praia da Arrifana alongside beach cleanups, music, art and cultural activities. The 2026 edition ran from late March through May.

events.name: Festival da Batata-doce de Aljezur (Sweet Potato Festival)
events.blurb: One of the largest autumn food festivals in southern Portugal, celebrating Aljezur's renowned sweet potato with chef-prepared dishes, street food stalls and live entertainment. Free entry and parking.

events.name: Festival da Batata-Doce de Aljezur (Aljezur Sweet Potato Festival)
events.when: annually late November / early December; 2026 edition 28-30 November
events.blurb: Aljezur's flagship gastronomic festival celebrating its protected sweet potato, with around 150 exhibitors, tastings, cooking competitions, regional products and live music over a weekend at the town's multi-use centre. It draws thousands of visitors each year.

events.name: Aljezur Surf Fest
events.when: annually in spring (late April / early May); 2026 edition held 1-3 May
events.blurb: An annual surfing and beach-culture festival organised by Aljezur Surf Club, with surf competitions held at Arrifana Beach plus music, art, cinema, skateboarding and sustainability activities. The 2026 edition was its second/third running.

events.name: Festival da Batata-doce de Aljezur (Sweet Potato Festival)
events.blurb: Aljezur's flagship annual gastronomy festival celebrating its protected 'Lira' sweet potato, with showcooking, tastings, local produce stalls, crafts and live music. Entry and parking are free.

events.name: Festa dos Pescadores do Portinho da Arrifana (Fishermen's Festival)
events.blurb: Traditional fishermen's festival at the Portinho da Arrifana near Aljezur, featuring a procession by sea and a popular fair.

events.name: Aljezur Surf Fest
events.blurb: A month-long event in the Aljezur/Costa Vicentina area combining surfing, music, photography and culture, including a stage of the Southern Regional Surf Circuit held on Arrifana beach.

events.name: Festival do Sargo da Costa Vicentina
events.blurb: A gastronomy festival across the Aljezur and Vila do Bispo municipalities in which participating restaurants serve dishes based on locally caught sargo (white seabream).

events.name: Festival de Música Al-Mutamid
events.blurb: Long-running Arabic and Andalusian music festival honouring the poet-king Al-Mutamid, with concerts at the Auditorio Municipal de Albufeira. The 2026 edition featured the 1001 Nights Ensemble on 7 February and Yinnan Al Andalus on 9 February.

events.name: Festa de Nossa Senhora da Orada (Festa da Ourada)
events.blurb: Albufeira's traditional festival honouring Nossa Senhora da Orada, patron saint of fishermen, with a procession from the parish church to the seafront ending in a midnight fireworks display over Praia dos Pescadores.

events.name: Albufeira Carpe Nox (New Year's Eve)
events.blurb: Albufeira's flagship New Year's Eve celebration at Praia dos Pescadores, featuring fireworks, a drone and laser sea-and-sky show, plus free concerts and DJ sets on the beach.

events.name: Banho 29
events.when: annually on the night of 29 August
events.blurb: An ancient Algarve end-of-summer tradition in which people gather on the seafront for a purifying midnight sea bath; celebrated along the Algarve coast (notably Lagos, Praia da Luz, Manta Rota and Odeceixe) with music and festivities.

events.name: Festival do Perceve (Goose Barnacle Festival)
events.when: annually (recent editions in June; historically late August/September)
events.blurb: Vila do Bispo, the self-proclaimed 'Capital dos Percebes', celebrates its hand-harvested goose barnacles with tastings, cooking demonstrations and live music in the municipal square. The festival is held annually around the local harvesting season.

events.name: Sagres Birdwatching Festival
events.blurb: One of Portugal's largest nature events, held in Sagres in the Vila do Bispo municipality, featuring field trips, boat and dolphin-watching tours, workshops, bird ringing sessions and guided hikes during the autumn raptor migration.

events.name: Marine Science Festival (Festival das Ciencias do Mar)
events.blurb: Organized by the University of Algarve and Vila do Bispo City Council in Sagres, the festival brings students, seniors and the general public closer to marine research and biodiversity through hands-on activities.

events.name: Vila do Bispo Monthly Market
events.blurb: A traditional monthly market held in front of the market hall in Vila do Bispo, the nearest town to Praia da Cordoama, on the first Thursday of each month.

events.name: Banho 29 (Midnight Swim Festival)
events.blurb: A centuries-old Lagos tradition where locals take a purifying midnight sea bath on 29 August to mark the end of summer, now celebrated with a weekend of live music, entertainment and fireworks at the beaches of Lagos and nearby Praia da Luz.

events.name: Festival dos Descobrimentos
events.when: annually late April / early May (2026: 30 Apr - 4 May)
events.blurb: An annual cultural festival in the historic centre of Lagos celebrating the town's role in the Portuguese Age of Discoveries, with parades, a medieval-style market, street performances, music and traditional crafts.

events.name: Festas em Honra de Nossa Senhora da Boa Viagem
events.blurb: Ericeira's main traditional festival honoring the patroness of fishermen, held annually in mid-August since 1947. Highlights include a procession of decorated boats out to sea, street celebrations, concerts, swimming competitions at Praia dos Pescadores, and fireworks.

events.name: WSL Challenger Series - Ericeira (MEO Vissla Pro)
events.when: annually, autumn; part of the 2026 WSL Challenger Series
events.blurb: Ericeira, the only World Surfing Reserve in continental Europe, hosts a World Surf League Challenger Series event, a qualifying platform for the Championship Tour. The competition is held at the Ribeira d'Ilhas pointbreak just north of town.

praia-da-gale.town: Armação de Pêra (between Albufeira and Armação de Pêra, Algarve)

events.name: Festival da Caldeirada de Armação de Pêra (Fish Stew Festival)
events.blurb: Annual seafood festival in the fishing town of Armação de Pêra (organised by Silves municipality) promoting local sea products, with more than a dozen participating restaurants serving the traditional caldeirada fish stew. The 2026 edition runs 22-24 May.

events.name: Santos Populares / Festa dos Pescadores, Armação de Pêra
events.blurb: Traditional June popular-saints celebration in Armação de Pêra honouring the fishing community and Our Lady of the Navigators (Nossa Senhora dos Navegantes), with a seaside procession of decorated boats, open-air mass, grilled sardines, music and fireworks.

events.name: Algarve Smooth Jazz Festival (Pine Cliffs Resort)
events.blurb: International jazz, soul and funk festival held at the Pine Cliffs Resort near Albufeira, with oceanfront performances. The 2026 edition runs 12-18 May.

praia-da-granja.town: São Félix da Marinha (Vila Nova de Gaia), adjacent to Espinho

events.name: Festas de São Félix da Marinha
events.blurb: The annual patron-saint festivities of São Félix da Marinha, the parish that includes Praia da Granja, with an opening ceremony, brass bands, folklore festival, musical performances and a solemn mass.

events.name: Festas em Honra de São Pedro (Espinho)
events.blurb: One of the largest pilgrimages in the Espinho municipality, honoring Saint Peter (patron of fishermen) with a large procession through the streets of the nearby seaside city of Espinho.

events.name: Festa de Nossa Senhora do Mar (Silvalde, Espinho)
events.blurb: Celebration in honor of Nossa Senhora do Mar, patron saint of local fishermen, held in the Silvalde fishing district of nearby Espinho on the first weekend of August.

events.name: Festival Internacional de Música de Espinho (FIME)
events.when: annually June to July (2026: 19 June - 31 July)
events.blurb: Long-running international music festival in the nearby city of Espinho, with over four decades of history; the 2026 edition runs from 19 June to 31 July with classical and jazz concerts.

events.name: Festival do Perceve (Goose Barnacle Festival)
events.blurb: Vila do Bispo's signature gastronomy festival celebrating the locally harvested goose barnacle (perceve), with tastings, music and craft stalls. The event draws over 11,000 visitors each year and reached its 11th edition in 2025.

events.name: Sagres Birdwatching & Nature Activities Festival
events.blurb: Portugal's largest nature festival, held in the Vila do Bispo / Sagres area, featuring guided bird and dolphin-watching excursions, workshops, talks and field trips. Organized by Vila do Bispo Municipal Council with SPEA and Almargem.

events.name: Festival das Ciencias do Mar (Marine Science Festival)
events.blurb: A marine science festival in Sagres organized with the University of Algarve, with school activities focused on marine research and biodiversity and a public open day. Held in the Vila do Bispo municipality, the coastal area that includes Praia da Ingrina.

events.name: Albufeira Radical
events.when: annually in spring (2026 edition held 2-4 April)
events.blurb: A three-day urban and radical sports festival at Praia dos Pescadores in Albufeira featuring skateboarding, BMX, climbing, surf and kayak demonstrations alongside free live music. The 2026 first edition is part of the Albufeira European City of Sport 2026 programme.

events.name: Festa da Sardinha de Olhos de Água (Sardine Festival)
events.blurb: A traditional three-day sardine festival in the nearby fishing area of Olhos de Água, serving freshly grilled sardines with boiled potatoes, tomato salad and regional wine, accompanied by live music. Organised by the Albufeira and Olhos de Água Parish Council with free admission.

events.name: Dia do Município de Albufeira (Municipal Holiday)
events.blurb: Albufeira's municipal holiday marks the granting of its Charter of Privilege by King Manuel I in 1504, celebrated with sports events, official ceremonies, a seaside concert and a fireworks display at Praia dos Pescadores.

events.name: Algarve Smooth Jazz Festival
events.blurb: An annual oceanfront jazz, soul and funk festival held at the Pine Cliffs Resort in Albufeira, bringing international artists for a week of performances near the cliffs of the Algarve coast.

events.name: Vilamoura Marina International Boat Show
events.blurb: An annual nautical show at Vilamoura Marina featuring over 35 exhibitors, 50 brands and 100+ boats, plus nautical equipment and water-sports activities. Admission is free.

events.name: Festa em Honra de Nossa Senhora da Conceicao (Quarteira)
events.blurb: Quarteira's patron-saint festival, held each 7-8 December, beginning with an evening candle procession between local churches and culminating in a solemn procession toward the sea. Organised by the parish and Loule municipal council.

events.name: Loule Carnival (Carnaval de Loule)
events.blurb: Portugal's longest-running Carnival, with over a century of parades, satirical floats and dancers along Avenida Jose da Costa Mealha in nearby Loule.

events.name: Enofilo Wine Fest Vilamoura
events.blurb: A walk-around wine tasting in Vilamoura featuring around 35 producers and over 300 wines, with a special focus on wines of the Algarve.

events.name: Festa em Honra de Nossa Senhora da Rocha
events.when: annually on the first Sunday of August
events.blurb: Traditional religious festival centred on the cliff-top chapel above Praia da Senhora da Rocha. The saint's image is carried down to the beach for a procession and a 'blessing of the sea' rite for fishermen and their boats, followed by a solemn Mass and community celebration.

events.name: Festival da Batata-Doce de Aljezur (Aljezur Sweet Potato Festival)
events.blurb: One of southern Portugal's largest autumn food festivals, celebrating Aljezur's famous protected sweet potato with food stalls, tastings, crafts and live music. Free entry and parking, held in Aljezur town near Praia das Adegas.

events.name: Feira do Folar e da Doçaria de Odeceixe (Odeceixe Easter Pastry Fair)
events.blurb: Traditional Easter fair in Odeceixe, the nearest town to Praia das Adegas, showcasing the regional folar pastry, local sweets, crafts and live music. The 16th edition runs over the Easter weekend.

events.name: ESTAR - Encontros de Teatro e Animação de Rua
events.blurb: A street theatre and performance festival held in the village of Odeceixe, bringing live outdoor cultural animation to the streets of the town nearest Praia das Adegas.

events.name: Feira de Odeceixe (Odeceixe Fair)
events.blurb: A traditional annual fair in Odeceixe held on the first Sunday of September, featuring regional products, crafts and local entertainment.

events.name: Banho 29 (Festa do Banho 29)
events.blurb: A centuries-old Algarve tradition in which people bathe in the sea on 29 August to symbolically purify body and soul; Praia de Monte Clérigo is one of the main beaches where the ritual is held, typically with a bath around 11:00 and accompanying folk music. The day is also Aljezur's municipal holiday.

events.name: Festas de Aljezur
events.blurb: Aljezur's main annual town festival held around the municipal holiday, featuring a white-dress 'Noite Branca' night in the historic centre with food, crafts, music and entertainment, and culminating in the Banho 29 sea-bathing tradition at nearby Praia de Monte Clérigo.

events.name: Festival da Batata-doce de Aljezur (Aljezur Sweet Potato Festival)
events.blurb: One of southern Portugal's largest autumn food festivals, celebrating Aljezur's EU-protected (IGP) sweet potato with restaurants, snack bars, street food and sweet-potato-based pastries, drinks and desserts. Entrance and parking are free.

praia-de-monte-gordo.town: Monte Gordo (Vila Real de Santo António, Algarve)

events.name: Festas de Nossa Senhora das Dores (Monte Gordo)
events.when: annually, second weekend of September (around 10-15 September)
events.blurb: Monte Gordo's traditional patron-saint festival, rooted in the village's fishing heritage. Its highlight is a distinctive religious procession that runs along Monte Gordo beach, accompanied by fishing boats sounding their horns, plus evening music shows, a trade fair near the casino, and a closing fireworks display.

events.name: Monte Gordo Sand Race
events.blurb: An annual motorcycle and quad beach race held directly on the sands of Monte Gordo beach, run over a temporary 6 km course in two heats with categories including women, veterans, vintage and juniors. Since 2023 it has been a round of the FIM Sand Races World Cup.

events.name: Passagem de Ano de Monte Gordo (New Year's Eve)
events.blurb: Monte Gordo's free New Year's Eve celebration features live concerts and a midnight fireworks display over the bay, one of the larger end-of-year events on the eastern Algarve coast.

events.name: Festa da Praia Maravilha (Wonderful Beach Party)
events.blurb: Held on Praia de Odeceixe itself, this beach party celebrates Odeceixe's 2012 election as one of the '7 Wonders - Beaches of Portugal'. Organised by the Parish of Odeceixe and the Municipality of Aljezur, it combines live music with sport such as bodyboard competitions.

events.name: Festival da Batata-doce de Aljezur (Aljezur Sweet Potato Festival)
events.blurb: One of southern Portugal's largest autumn food festivals, held in Aljezur (the municipality and nearest town to Odeceixe beach), celebrating the region's famous sweet potato with over 100 exhibitors. The 2026 edition is scheduled for 28-30 November with free entry and parking.

events.name: Feira do Folar de Odeceixe (Odeceixe Easter Cake Fair)
events.blurb: A traditional Easter fair in the village of Odeceixe celebrating the local 'folar' Easter cake, with regional food, crafts and entertainment.

events.name: Festa de Nossa Senhora da Piedade
events.blurb: Traditional patron-saint religious festivity celebrated in Odeceixe in mid-August.

events.name: Romaria de São Bartolomeu do Mar (Banho Santo)
events.blurb: Centuries-old pilgrimage in the São Bartolomeu do Mar parish of Esposende, near Ofir, where young children are dipped three times in the sea in the famous 'Banho Santo' ritual said to ward off evil and cure ailments. The day also features a procession of biblical figures between the chapel and the beach.

events.name: Festas da Cidade de Esposende
events.blurb: Esposende's main town festival, held in August around the Feast of Nossa Senhora da Saúde, combining religious processions and fireworks with concerts by national artists in the riverside area, drawing thousands of visitors.

events.name: O Verão sai à Rua / Festa do Emigrante
events.blurb: A summer street program in Esposende centred on Largo Rodrigues Sampaio, opening with the Festa do Emigrante to welcome returning emigrants, with live music, local gastronomy, crafts and cultural animation.

events.name: Galaicofolia
events.blurb: A historical re-enactment event in Esposende celebrating the Castreja (Celtic-Galician) culture at the origins of the region, part of the municipality's summer cultural calendar.

events.name: Festas do Pescador (Fisherman's Festival)
events.blurb: Albufeira's annual Fisherman's Festival fills the Praca dos Pescadores by the Old Town beach with grilled sardines, octopus salad, fish stews, live music and cultural performances over three free, family-friendly days. It is organised by the Albufeira municipality and celebrates the town's fishing heritage.

events.name: Algarve Smooth Jazz Festival
events.blurb: The Algarve Smooth Jazz Festival is held annually in May at the Pine Cliffs Resort in Albufeira, bringing together leading international contemporary, soul and funk jazz artists. The 2026 edition runs from 12 to 17 May.

events.name: Festival de Musica al-Mutamid
events.blurb: An Algarve-wide festival of Arabic and Middle Eastern music with a 2026 concert at the Auditorio Municipal de Albufeira on 7 February featuring the 1001 Nights Ensemble.

events.name: Festival da Batata-Doce de Aljezur (Aljezur Sweet Potato Festival)
events.blurb: Long-running gastronomy festival (since 1998) in Aljezur celebrating the local PGI-protected Lyra sweet potato, with showcooking, tastings of sweet and savoury dishes, music and entertainment. Free entry, held at the Aljezur Multipurpose Space about 10 km from the beach.

events.name: Aljezur Surf Fest
events.when: annually spring (March-May); 2026 stages incl. 28-29 March, 18-19 April, 25-26 April, 1-3 May
events.blurb: Month-long celebration of surf culture, sport and sustainability across the beaches of Aljezur municipality, including a stage of the Southern Regional Surf Circuit for junior athletes, beach clean-up actions and an open-air fair with music, art and cinema.

events.name: Festival de Folclore do Rogil (Rogil Folklore Festival)
events.blurb: Traditional folklore festival held in the village of Rogil, the nearest locality to Praia de Vale dos Homens, showcasing regional dance and music groups.

praia-de-vieira.town: Vieira de Leiria (Praia da Vieira), Marinha Grande, Portugal

events.name: Festa da Sardinha (Sardine Festival)
events.when: annually late June, at Largo dos Pescadores on Praia da Vieira
events.blurb: A three-day seafood and music festival held at the Largo dos Pescadores (fishermen's square) on Praia da Vieira, featuring grilled sardines and other local gastronomy, live concerts and family activities, organized by the Municipality of Marinha Grande.

events.name: Festival do Carapau (Jack Mackerel Festival)
events.when: annually mid-to-late July, at Largo dos Pescadores on Praia da Vieira
events.blurb: An annual gastronomy festival centred on the carapau (Atlantic horse mackerel), held at the Largo dos Pescadores on Praia da Vieira with three days of traditional food, shows and entertainment, organized by the Municipality of Marinha Grande with the local volunteer firefighters.

events.name: Festas da Capela da Praia da Vieira (Nossa Senhora dos Navegantes e Sao Pedro)
events.blurb: Traditional religious festivities at the Praia da Vieira chapel honouring Nossa Senhora dos Navegantes and Sao Pedro, patron of fishermen, with processions and popular celebrations.

events.name: Festiv'Alvaro
events.when: annually in summer (August), evenings on Praia da Vieira
events.blurb: An annual open-air theatre festival animating the summer nights of Praia da Vieira, featuring performances by the local Teatresco group and guest theatre companies.

events.name: Festa do Pescador (Albufeira Fisherman's Festival)
events.when: annually first weekend of September (2026: Sept 4-6)
events.blurb: Annual festival held since 1997 at Praca dos Pescadores by Albufeira's Fishermen's Beach, celebrating the town's fishing heritage with regional seafood gastronomy, folklore music and dance. Free and family-friendly.

events.name: Algarve Smooth Jazz Festival
events.blurb: Annual smooth jazz festival at the clifftop Pine Cliffs Resort in Albufeira, above Praia da Falesia, featuring international jazz, soul and funk artists. The 2026 edition is its 9th year.

events.name: Festival da Sardinha (Portimao Sardine Festival)
events.blurb: The Algarve's flagship gastronomic event, held for over 25 years on Portimao's riverside, celebrating the summer sardine season with grilled sardines, live music and traditional fare. Held in the wider Algarve near Albufeira.

events.name: TUDOR Nazaré Big Wave Challenge
events.when: annually, competition window November–March (a single "on" day called when swells peak)
events.blurb: World Surf League big-wave tow-in surf event held right at Praia do Norte, where the world's best surfers ride waves of 12-15m+. The event runs on a flexible window and is called on a single day of peak swell; the 2025/26 edition ran on 13 December 2025 before more than 10,000 spectators.

events.name: Festa de Nossa Senhora da Nazaré
events.when: annually in early-to-mid September (feast day 8 September)
events.blurb: Nazaré's biggest annual celebration, a pilgrimage and religious festival in the clifftop Sítio area honouring Our Lady of Nazaré. It features processions, traditional folk music and dancing, bullfights, fireworks and street food, with local women often in traditional seven-petticoat dress.

events.name: Festas do Pescador (Fisherman's Festival)
events.blurb: Albufeira's Fisherman's Festival turns the Praça/Praia dos Pescadores, beside Praia do Tunel, into a large fair of fresh seafood, regional wines and sweets, folk dance and live music, honoring the town's fishing heritage. Running since 1997.

events.name: Festa de Nossa Senhora da Orada (Procession by the Sea)
events.blurb: A 500-year-old religious tradition honoring Our Lady of Orada, patron saint of fishermen, with the image of the Virgin paraded through Albufeira and carried by sea in a procession of dozens of boats along the coast. Includes fireworks and music.

events.name: Dia do Municipio de Albufeira (Municipal Holiday)
events.blurb: Albufeira's municipal holiday marks the granting of the town's charter (Foral) by King Manuel I in 1504, celebrated with official ceremonies, municipal awards, seaside concerts and fireworks at Praia dos Pescadores.

events.name: Albufeira Wine Fair (Feira de Vinhos)
events.blurb: Annual wine fair at the Espaco Multiusos de Albufeira featuring more than 100 exhibitors of regional and national wines, with tastings and entertainment.

events.name: Noite de São João (St. John's Bonfires at Praia Formosa)
events.blurb: On the eve of St. John's Day it is traditional in Funchal to celebrate with bonfires lit on the pebble beaches of Praia Formosa, part of the wider Santos Populares celebrations. Locals gather around the fires with food, music and grilled traditional fare.

events.name: Festa dos Santos Populares (Festival of the Popular Saints)
events.when: annually, June (8 June to 1 July in 2026)
events.blurb: One of Madeira's most beloved festivals, honouring St. Anthony, St. John and St. Peter with decorated streets, processions, traditional Madeiran food stalls, bonfires, music and dance throughout Funchal.

events.name: Festival of the Atlantic (International Fireworks Competition)
events.when: annually throughout June; fireworks contest 6, 13, 20 and 27 June 2026
events.blurb: A month-long Funchal festival combining classical concerts, street performances and an international fireworks competition staged over Funchal bay every Saturday in June, with displays synchronised to music at around 22:30.

events.name: Funchal New Year's Eve Fireworks
events.blurb: Funchal's famed New Year fireworks light up the bay from dozens of fire pits along the waterfront, a display once recognised by Guinness World Records as the world's largest fireworks show. It is visible across the Funchal amphitheatre, including from the Praia Formosa area.

praia-grande.town: Colares (Sintra), with the beach itself at Praia Grande do Rodízio

events.name: Sintra Bodyboard Pro Fest
events.blurb: International professional bodyboard competition held on the waves of Praia Grande, organised by the Sintra coast bodyboard/surf association with the Sintra municipality. In 2026 it is a stage of the World Bodyboard Championship circuit and the only round held in continental European waters.

events.name: Regional Surf Circuit of Greater Lisbon (Praia Grande stage)
events.blurb: Praia Grande regularly hosts a stage of the Greater Lisbon regional surf circuit, with competitions in under-14, under-16 and under-18 categories.

events.name: Festas de Nossa Senhora da Praia
events.blurb: Traditional five-day religious and popular festival at neighbouring Praia das Macas in Colares, dating to the 1890s. Its highlight is a seaside procession in which the image of Nossa Senhora da Praia is carried by surfers into the sea, marking the end of summer; it is recognised among the Seven Wonders of Portuguese Popular Culture.

events.name: Algarve Smooth Jazz Festival
events.when: annually in May (at Pine Cliffs Resort, above Praia Santa Eulalia)
events.blurb: An annual smooth jazz, soul and funk festival held at the Pine Cliffs Resort, the clifftop resort directly above Praia Santa Eulalia in Albufeira, with international artists performing oceanfront concerts. The 10th edition is scheduled for 11-16 May 2027.

events.name: Festa da Nossa Senhora da Orada
events.when: annually early-to-mid August, main procession on 14 August
events.blurb: Albufeira's traditional festival honouring Nossa Senhora da Orada, patron saint of fishermen, with the highlight on 14 August: a Eucharist at the Chapel of Nossa Senhora da Orada followed by a sea procession, the blessing of fishing boats and fireworks over the bay.

events.name: Albufeira Municipal Holiday (Dia do Municipio)
events.blurb: Albufeira's municipal holiday on 20 August is marked with public celebrations including concerts and fireworks in the town.

events.name: Festival al-Mutamid
events.when: annually (held early February at Auditorio Municipal de Albufeira)
events.blurb: A touring world-music festival celebrating Arabic and Mediterranean musical traditions, staged at the Auditorio Municipal de Albufeira as part of the wider al-Mutamid programme across the Algarve and Andalusia.

events.name: Dias Medievais em Castro Marim (Castro Marim Medieval Festival)
events.blurb: One of the Algarve's main cultural events, held each August around the Gothic castle of Castro Marim, recreating the Middle Ages with parades, jousting tournaments, medieval music, craft and food stalls. The 26th edition runs 26-30 August 2026.

events.name: Festa em Honra do Imaculado Coracao de Maria, Altura
events.blurb: Annual religious festival in honour of the Immaculate Heart of Mary held in Altura, the village nearest Praia Verde, featuring a craft fair (Feira de Artesanato), music and entertainment over an early-July weekend.

events.name: Festa da Nossa Senhora da Piedade (Feast of Our Lady of Piety)
events.blurb: Caniçal's centuries-old fishermen's festival honouring Our Lady of Piety, protector of fishermen. Colourfully decorated boats sail around the bay of Caniçal in a maritime procession, with the chapel above Prainha beach as a focal point of the celebrations.

events.name: Festival do Atum, do Gaiado e do Marisco (Tuna, Skipjack and Seafood Festival)
events.blurb: A three-day gastronomic festival held in the fishing village of Caniçal honouring local fishermen, featuring tuna and skipjack (gaiado) dishes, regional seafood delicacies, live music and entertainment.

events.name: Festa do Senhor (Quiaios)
events.blurb: Traditional religious festival in the village of Quiaios held on the first Sunday of September, featuring a procession through the village streets that returns to the parish church.

events.name: RFM Somnii Intermarché
events.blurb: Large annual electronic music festival ('the biggest sunset ever') held on the beach at Praia do Relogio in nearby Figueira da Foz; the 2026 edition runs 10-12 July with headliners including Hardwell, Timmy Trumpet and Vini Vici.

events.name: Gliding Barnacles Surf/Art/Music/Food Festival
events.blurb: Annual festival combining surfing, art, music and gastronomy held at Praia do Cabedelo in nearby Figueira da Foz; the 2026 edition takes place 23-27 September.

events.name: Festas da Cidade - Sao Joao (Figueira da Foz)
events.blurb: Figueira da Foz's city festival and Saint John celebrations run roughly 8-24 June with popular marches (the Quiaios Clube takes part), concerts, arraiais and fireworks, culminating on City Day, 24 June.

events.name: Festas de São Tomé e Nossa Senhora do Alívio (Estela)
events.blurb: The main annual religious and popular festival of Estela, the parish where Rio Alto Beach is located. Four days of processions with cavalry, marching bands, folk music, fairs and fireworks honouring St. Thomas and Our Lady of Relief.

events.name: Festas de São Pedro da Póvoa de Varzim
events.blurb: Póvoa de Varzim's largest annual festivity, honouring Saint Peter, with the city's six historic neighbourhoods decorating their streets, sardine feasts, processions, the traditional Rusga folk parade, pyromusical fireworks and concerts. In 2026 it runs from 25 June to 5 July.

events.name: Feira da Estela (Estela Market)
events.blurb: Weekly Sunday market in Estela, the rural parish next to Rio Alto Beach, known especially for locally grown horticultural produce.

events.name: Festas de São Pedro
events.when: annually late June to early July (2026: June 25 - July 5)
events.blurb: Póvoa de Varzim's main popular festival honoring Saint Peter, the fishermen's patron, with neighborhood altars, sardine grills, processions, bonfires and a midnight pyromusical fireworks show along Avenida dos Banhos (the seafront beside Praia da Salgueira). Saint Peter's Day mass and procession fall on June 29.

events.name: Corrida de São Pedro
events.blurb: A 10 km road race held as part of the São Pedro festivities, starting near the Varzim Stadium in Póvoa de Varzim.

events.name: Festa do Mar
events.blurb: A three-day seafood gastronomy festival at the Auditório da Lota celebrating Póvoa de Varzim's maritime culinary heritage, with regional fish and shellfish dishes such as grilled sardines, caldeirada, pescada à poveira and octopus.

events.name: Festival Internacional de Folclore da Póvoa de Varzim
events.blurb: A long-running international folklore festival in Póvoa de Varzim bringing together folk-dance and music groups from Portugal and abroad; the event has run for more than 30 editions.

santo-andre-beach.town: Vila Nova de Santo André / Costa de Santo André (Santiago do Cacém, Alentejo)

events.name: Festival da Enguia da Lagoa de Santo André
events.when: annually late January to early February (2026: 23 Jan - 8 Feb)
events.blurb: Gastronomic festival celebrating the eels of the Lagoa de Santo André, with participating local restaurants serving fried, grilled and stewed eel dishes (caldeirada, ensopado). The 11th edition runs 23 January to 8 February 2026.

events.name: Abertura da Lagoa de Santo André ao Mar (Opening of the Lagoon to the Sea)
events.when: annually in March, around the spring equinox
events.blurb: A two-centuries-old tradition in which a channel is opened through the beach to connect the Lagoa de Santo André to the sea, renewing the lagoon's water and allowing fish to enter. Hundreds of people gather on the Costa de Santo André to watch; the exact date varies each year with the tides.

events.name: Festas de São Romão / Banho de São Romão
events.blurb: Annual festival of the Santo André parish featuring an ethnographic recreation of the traditional 'Banho de São Romão' (Saint Romão Bath) at the Lagoa de Santo André, with a procession to the Costa de Santo André performed by local folk dance groups.
